checks.claim: Actual direct and complementary fourth rates give the stated split minimum.
checks.detail: The actual normalized/raw bridges use Ah=delta^2*kappa*L/h, Sh=(2p)*p*delta^2 and Bh=(2p)^2*sqrt(p)*delta^2/h, with C=max(intrinsicSeededDerivativeConstant C0,capSeededComplementaryConstant). The generic cap_abs_le_split_min is proved by the two scalar crossing cases; no analytic remainder bound is assumed by the final theorem. Using p instead of the support rank is permitted because only a dimension logarithm is retained.

checks.claim: The first actual scalar minimum integral covers every crossing location.
checks.detail: For c=(S/A)^2, the proof handles c<=epsilon, c>=1+epsilon, and an interior crossing separately. The tail bound is2S/sqrt(c)=2A; the direct logarithm is2A*log(S/(A*sqrt(epsilon))). Positive-part logarithms give the same bound outside the interval. All scalar functions are genuinely continuous and interval-integrable on the positive interval.

checks.claim: The second scalar minimum integral covers all crossing cases and the endpoint5/4.
checks.detail: For c=(A/B)^2 the lower branch integrates B/sqrt(v), the upper branch A/v. The explicit bound2A+A*logplus(b/c) and b<=5/4 imply the stated4A*(1+logplus(B/A)) bound. Cases with crossing outside the interval are included.

checks.claim: The seed removes h from both crossing ratios and confines p/r factors to CL.
checks.detail: Exact sqrt(L*h^2)=sqrt(L)*h for h>0 gives the two printed ratios. For m=2p,r<=p,kappa>=1,L>=1, the proved logarithm bounds are4L and6L. Summing crossing integrals gives38*C*Ah*L. Direct integration of C*Ah/v gives C*Ah*(1+log(1/epsilon)); their minimum gives the literal capped time cost.

It does not require a derivative-integrability supplier. The separate raw/normalized integral endpoints do use actual G3 absolute time-integrability.
